package.name: custom_config
package.description:
Workspace-owned configuration and launch for the Hokuyo UST-10LX, kept out of the urg_node2 submodule so `git submodule update` cannot revert it. Upstream's launch file hardcodes its parameter file path with no override, so owning the launch is the only way to own the parameters.
Lives beside the urg_node2 submodule so everything laser-related stays in lidar/, mirroring camera/custom_covariance. Nothing here is vendor content.
